page.overview:
What is DJ Music Man?

DJ Music Man is a DJ animatronic from Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex who makes minor appearances in the Tales from the Pizzaplex Series.

DJ Music Man appears in the story Bobbiedots, Part 1 from the book Tales from the Pizzaplex #4: Submechanophobia. He appears in a segment where Abe is training Preston to be a Pizzaplex technician. He is stated to have had an "experimental bouncer mode" which was removed. However, some of the code stayed, causing DJ Music Man to be aggressive, sticking his hand through the restroom door and nearly grabbing Preston.
